blockingFindings.summary: Java completion does not prove the producer has settled its final private acknowledgement or sticky failure path.
blockingFindings.sourceEvidence: Event8 writes ackBracketMicros and event9 writes closed inside p4RevocationNotice before sendResponseHeaders/getResponseBody.write. Native event3 also removes the active ordinal before its reply. p4AwaitRevocationObserverCompletion checks only server-side flags, state.failed and the current existence of a local marker. revEmit validates response.json/status/shape later on revTail, with revFail in its asynchronous catch. Cleanup can observe all flags and clear mode/state before that final validation finishes. Ordinary process.exit forwards immediately and never establishes observer-tail completion.
blockingFindings.concreteFailureSchedule: Last required notice reaches Java and sets completion; Java checks flags/marker and clears mode; the reply is lost, malformed or fails producer parsing afterward; revFail runs after the checks, or the ordinary producer exits first. The source has no final producer watermark/tail-settled evidence to make that failure precede PASS.
blockingFindings.impact: Sticky failure is present while noticed, but final private reply failures are not fenced into the verdict. Missing required ingress normally fails; this distinct after-ingress race can escape that guard.
blockingFindings.boundedResolution: In the already approved scalar-only observer/owned cleanup path, establish completion of each selected producer and its pending acknowledgement/failure processing before observer OFF and the final sticky check. Preserve original operation promises and original exit/STOP behavior; do not insert waits into original operations, reset poll clocks, fake FINAL or add a product API. An unresolved tail is failure, never a success marker.
blockingFindings.runtime: UNRUN; source ordering counterexample, not a reproduced runtime failure.

blockingFindings.summary: Owner-level counts and scope checks do not establish the requested LIVE_RECHECK/USED linkage to the actual consumed release.
blockingFindings.sourceEvidence: The new case separately requires one RESOLVED RELEASE, one LIVE_RECHECK REVOKED_MID_RUN and one USED, filtered only by selected session/execution and PASS. p3AssertAuditScope selects principal/csi/environment/test/secret, asserts rows.size>=2 and checks those fields. It selects no release identity/parent relation, attempt, admission, fence or action coordinate. p3AssertBinding checks ordinary artifact/revision/scope; p3RunnerReport checks FINAL identity separately.
blockingFindings.concreteCounterexample: Rows with correct selected owner and scope but wrong release linkage or action/attempt identity still satisfy these independent counts and the >=2 scope loop. A second LIVE_RECHECK with another outcome is also not excluded by counting only REVOKED_MID_RUN.
blockingFindings.impact: These assertions are nonvacuous and do establish fresh read delta1 and genuine-looking scoped row categories. They do not justify the stronger candidate claim of a revocation audit against the actual release or persistence of the identical prior positive usage.
blockingFindings.boundedResolution: Use read-only queries/assertions over existing authentic release/usage/recheck identities and their existing links, bound to the selected actual owner/action/attempt/fence where available. Capture the pre-flip positive usage identity and require it unchanged after original teardown; check relevant recheck cardinality rather than only a filtered outcome count. Keep exported evidence numeric/value-free; no row insertion, schema change, authorization/fence mutation or product edit.

blockingFindings.summary: The ordinal3 click settlement category is consumed and discarded, so the report cannot describe the actual residual outcome.
blockingFindings.sourceEvidence: The wrapper emits event3 with ok=true/false. Java removes the active ordinal and records ok only when operation==1 to establish prior fill success. For the identified click operation2/ordinal3, no state retains whether its original promise fulfilled or rejected. Completion requires only active.isEmpty. p3WriteEvidence exports ordinal3 and prior usage booleans but no click settlement category.
blockingFindings.impact: Both original click fulfillment and rejection satisfy completion and generate the same scalar evidence. Actual accepted SignIn POST is proved separately, but it cannot stand in for settlement of the residual original click promise. This is not a DOM-write or midfill finding.
blockingFindings.boundedResolution: Retain and export only the approved closed settlement category for the exact inFlightOrdinal, require exactly one corresponding settlement, and distinguish accepted POST effect from native promise fulfillment/rejection. Do not inspect result/error objects or expose their bytes.
blockingFindings.runtime: UNRUN; deterministic loss of an already emitted scalar.

approvedSourceOnly.subject: Completed positive ACK authenticity
approvedSourceOnly.finding: Ordinary wrapper calls the actual createFetchHttpClient send once and returns that original promise. Its success observer sees response.text fully completed, status200, exact execution control identity/shape and both cancel/revoked false through actual validSecretControl and ackRequestsCancel. Guided checkGrant original success with initial=false follows original complete-body202 parsing and session/owner/fence/lease validation. It is an accepted-grant validation boundary, before renew applies the returned lease; no fake202/control payload is introduced.

approvedSourceOnly.subject: Conservative authority clock and scoped atomic denial
approvedSourceOnly.finding: Java samples System.nanoTime immediately before AtomicBoolean revoked.set(true), which makes the original controlled entitlement port deny both granted aliases for CSI-456/fixture-other/PASS; both actual set entries are then removed and missing tuples fail. CSI-123 compatibility is untouched. Java event5 ingress takes the same clock. The exact positive delta<=2000ms includes original request, poll/renew, IPC and scalar-delivery queues after the flip. Ack-to-private-reply micros use only the Node clock; they are not subtracted from Java timing. Original poll/renew epochs, timeout and promise return are unchanged.
approvedSourceOnly.limits: No executed <=2s proof, worst-phase proof, slow900 or lost-body conclusion.

approvedSourceOnly.subject: Original current Ready/STOP and guided cutoff
approvedSourceOnly.finding: ProcessLike adapter forwards real process.on/send/exit receiver/arguments/result once. Actual Ready3 is validated after the original send and runId must equal the selected execution. STOP is observed only after the unchanged listener returns and the actual Stop schema validates. Current observed SDK synchronously aborts on that branch. Guided invalidate post-return observes stopped; stop post-call observes accepting=false plus a closed reason. Completion separately requires actual REVOKED reason, actual revoked_at and SECRET_USE_REVOKED; a generic guided invalidation alone cannot complete the case.

approvedSourceOnly.subject: Narrow native capability/privacy and forwarding
approvedSourceOnly.finding: After original GuidedRuntime.start success/accepting, the observer transiently reaches only the already started private browser.observations capability and decorates fillPassword/invoke. It reads only the allowed invoke operation.kind discriminator, not selectors/values/inventories/results/errors/cookies/CDP. Original receiver/args/synchronous error/result promise are forwarded once; added promise observers do not replace or await the original promise. Ordinary decoration uses the existing selected Ready-bound session factory. Own descriptors are saved/restored; false define/delete or changed wrapper identity calls sticky revFail. No new product API, CDP hook or object inventory is added.
approvedSourceOnly.limits: Private capability access is reviewed under the user-stated prior privacy approval, not a newly expanded authorization.

approvedSourceOnly.subject: Prior fill/USED and exact one pending click
approvedSourceOnly.finding: Flip requires started, successful original fill settlement, actual accepted SignIn POST, active.size==1 with operation2 and ordinal3, plus actual committed USED count1. The barrier holds the original SignIn response and releases only after cutoff or failure-finally. It changes neither the submitted action nor native primitive count. Native entry establishes entry, not DOM writes. Settlement requires the residual ordinal removed; its category gap is PAIR-SOURCE-03.

approvedSourceOnly.subject: Restoration and no new primitive source behavior
approvedSourceOnly.finding: Guided revRestore runs before original Runtime.stop, whose cleanup later disposes observations. Ordinary revRestore runs after original STOP returns: synchronous abort/finish may already have initiated browser close, but promise continuations and observation-session disposal occur later. In the unchanged ordinary SDK, parent abort/control.check/live gates further native entry; guided accepting/live gates it. The native decorators are removed at cutoff, so post-restoration absence is a source-path conclusion, not continued native-entry observation. Do not describe the active-map guard as measuring every post-cutoff call.
approvedSourceOnly.limits: Not a runtime negative-action receipt, complete midfill proof or guarantee about underlying DOM effects of the sole already pending click.

approvedSourceOnly.subject: Genuine owner lifecycle, FINAL, artifact and model assertions
approvedSourceOnly.finding: New ordinary case learns/publishes with revocation mode off, executes the original published artifact and reasserts its identity/bytes before and after replay; MODEL_WIRE delta is zero on ordinary replay. Actual forwarded 2xx authenticated FINAL is checked against ledger attempt/admission/runner/sequence. Original owned cleanup precedes observer OFF. Guided original teardown CONFIRMED is awaited. Revoked timestamp is required nonnull and reread equal after teardown; ordinary cancel_requested_at must remain null. This tests the no-user-cancel branch, not cancellation/completed precedence controls.
approvedSourceOnly.limits: Resource evidence is original FINAL/teardown source wiring, never elapsed-time or marker-as-resource proof. New pair still UNRUN; full process/profile/image cleanup cannot be certified by this review.

approvedSourceOnly.subject: Nonvacuous scopes/scanner and prohibited mutations
approvedSourceOnly.finding: Scope helper checks at least2 real rows and each principal/CSI/environment/test/secret against the selected original owner. New case separately asserts actual release1, USED1, revocation1, provider delta1 and receipt1; these are useful lower/count guards but not the missing join proof. Existing scanner and synthetic positive scanner controls are preserved. Patch adds read-only audit queries, controlled entitlement denial and private notices/barrier; it adds no audit/action/admission/lease inserts, fence/auth bypass, schema/budget/allowance/prod source mutation. Baseline fixture setup SQL remains unchanged.
approvedSourceOnly.limits: Scanner covers the existing named SQL tables, gateway, logs and owned journal/scratch/objects plus actual FINAL and provider erasure. It does not establish complete TRACE/SSE/metrics/profile/fault/privacy coverage.
